list: The official 55 trophies. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them; guides written for this entry in our own words.

sources.name: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: There is no separate task here: the platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Treat it as the finish line for the whole list below and expect roughly 200 hours across a single playthrough (difficulty about 4/10). Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger questlines, then the long collectible grinds — and the platinum will land on its own. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and finish it — the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer, Output Lag.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude and make a manual save — there is no mission replay. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer, Output Lag.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play through Chapter 2 to its end; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapter 2 also opens free-roam with your partner after the Coffee Break mission, which is when the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) become possible. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer, Output Lag.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy pops at the chapter close. Chapter 3 is where several stranger questlines (Andy, Randy, Tyrone) and the jewelry jobs open up, so pick those up as they appear rather than leaving them all for later. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer, Output Lag.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play Chapter 4 through to its final mission and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. The Chapter 4 bank-vault mission is also a natural spot for the 4-star escape trophy Hot Together, and the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks the bank vaults for Maximum Withdrawal. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer, Output Lag.

trophies.guide: The second gold and the longest grind in the game. Reach 100% Completion, tracked under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — the checklist only unlocks after the story. It is closer to 60% true completion, but it still demands a lot: 100 optional missions, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, all 42 shooting range golds, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 of 397 stunts. Chip away at it alongside the other trophies instead of saving it all for the end, and save the final cleanup for after the story when everything is open. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts out of 397 in total: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Stunts are tracked on the map and in your stats, so work through them region by region rather than hunting at random. Note that 100% Completion needs 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing the platinum. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, car races (including race challenges and Top Fun drone races) and stunts. None of them needs to be won or finished — one attempt at each is enough, so this pops early if you sample everything as it unlocks. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 2 shooting ranges at 12 locations. Gold means hitting the score threshold on every challenge, so expect retries on the trickier weapon drills — learn each challenge's target pattern first, then go for the gold run. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations (42 drone races in total). You only need one win per location, not every race, so learn each course's line and gates, win once, and move on to the next location. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of 40 unique race locations. Each location only counts once, so do not grind the same easy race — spread your wins across the map and use a fast, well-handling car you are comfortable with. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal during the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, then follow his fishing questline from the location he texts you. Work through his challenges and beat him in the fishing challenge he sets — fishing well means steady reeling and keeping the line tension in the safe zone rather than yanking. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade and video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind (played on the home TV) or Bang For Your Buck (on arcade machines). Pick the one you enjoy most — only one full completion is needed. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's questline, which is Lucia-only and marked from Chapter 3. There are five quests in the strand, ending with Puff Puff Pass — finish that final mission and the trophy pops. Do the quests as they appear so the strand does not get forgotten in the endgame. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's treasure-diving questline, which starts in Chapter 1 at Key Lento. Clear all seven shipwrecks to reach his final mission, then complete it. Diving gear and a boat make the wreck runs far quicker, and the wrecks double as progress toward the underwater discoveries needed for 100% Completion. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Follow Billy's Thrillbilly Mud Club questline, which opens in Chapter 2 after the Coffee Break mission. There are five quests in the strand, ending with Hometown Heroes — finish that final mission and the trophy pops. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida — but only certain strands count, including Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pete, with more still being confirmed by the guide community. Be warned: the strands for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this total, even though they have their own trophies. Track your counted strands and do not assume every stranger quest helps. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Follow Randy's Wish List, which opens in Chapter 3 after the Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS mission. Use the Key Cloner to deliver 16 sports cars, then finish his final mission. Keep an eye out for the requested models while free-roaming so the deliveries do not become a separate hunt. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's questline, which is Jason-only and opens in Chapter 3 after the Here, Kitty Kitty mission. Destroy the Synthetic Labs, then finish the Spin On This finale mission. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations — and meditate with BOTH Jason and Lucia at each spot, since each character's meditation counts separately (two per spot). THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY IN THE GAME: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house. After the Down to Earth mission, Lucia meditates on the balcony in the morning — follow her and Accept the prompt. The sources disagree on whether that one spot is strictly required, so do it anyway and keep a manual save from Chapter 1. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a missed spot cannot be revisited. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Follow Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break mission. Work through his 15 Target Decks to reach the unique-animal hunt. Note: the guides are still confirming exactly which animal pops the trophy, so check the latest community notes before the final hunt rather than assuming a target. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets found across Leonida. Cards are picked up in the world and tracked per set, so finish the sets whose cards cluster near each other first. Note that 100% Completion needs 15 sets, so this trophy is only the start of the card hunt. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Scan everything you pass while doing other trophies — landmarks and curiosities are everywhere, so this fills up naturally if you make a habit of opening WAiNK at each new place. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges in the game, tracked under Progress, Challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more, so mix them into normal play and check the list regularly to see which are nearly done. Note that 100% Completion needs 70 challenges. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Available once you can free-roam together after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break mission. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone on the map until the stars clear. If it does not pop on its own, it also tends to come naturally during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Available after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break mission, with your partner beside you. Rob three shops in a row while keeping your wanted level alive the whole time — do not let the heat die between robberies. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop. Pick three shops close together and plan a fast route between them. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app. Scan every new vehicle you see — parked cars, traffic, anything unfamiliar — and the count climbs fast. Note that 100% Completion needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so keep scanning long after this trophy pops. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim mode (L3+R3 while aiming). Activate it with at least five enemies in view and take down all five before it runs out. Gang guards at an illegal operation work well: they group up, they are armed, and you can retry the spot. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Go to Vice City International Airport and steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the gates E3 and E4 aircraft work. Get it moving, take off and fly about a kilometre away; the trophy pops with a delay, so keep flying rather than landing at once. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Find a Rhino military tank parked south of the Mile Zero Air Station, on the far south-west island, and climb in. That is all it takes — no mission, no fight, just get into the driver's seat. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun — use it on a jewelry store's locked back door, find the safe code note inside, open the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. Move slowly, avoid the staff's line of sight and do not trigger an alarm. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Bank vaults unlock through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — bring your partner, because one person cannot carry all the bags alone. Rob five vaults and escape the heat each time. There are eight vaults in total and 100% Completion needs all eight, so keep going after this trophy. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Tail an armored security van or hit an armored truck, grab the cash and then escape the heat zone until your wanted level clears. Plan an escape route before you strike — a fast car parked nearby and a route away from police makes the getaway simple. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida by exploring every region. Drive, fly and sail into each corner of the state — the map fills in as you go, so this pairs naturally with the WAiNK scans, the vehicle discoveries and the stunt hunting. Save a dedicated exploration sweep for after the story, when the whole map is open. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs running 39 illegal operations across Leonida. Rob one operation belonging to each gang — any one per gang counts. All 39 are needed for 100% Completion, so work through the full list rather than stopping at nine. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED: the guide community (PowerPyx and Keengamer) has not yet confirmed the exact unlock for this trophy, so treat this as the best-known approach, not a certainty. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — try ordering a cocktail at an Ocean Beach bar overlooking the water. Check the sources for the latest confirmed method before spending long on it. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED: the guide community (PowerPyx and Keengamer) has not yet confirmed the exact unlock for this trophy, so treat this as the best-known approach, not a certainty. The description points to a vehicle showroom: the classic-style approach is to drive a car straight out through the showroom front. Check the sources for the latest confirmed method before spending long on it. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates illegal operation in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take the three key valuables — the luxury watch, the shotgun and the office safe contents — then escape the police. If something is missed, the operation returns later, so you can retry it. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train together — your partner trains alongside you, so work out with both characters until each one maxes the stat. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Build up 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — robberies, fights and similar choices all feed the count. There is no trick to it: it fills up naturally over a full trophy run as you rob shops, fight and make criminal choices. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED: the guide community (PowerPyx and Keengamer) has not yet confirmed the exact unlock for this trophy, so treat this as the best-known approach, not a certainty. The name and description suggest succeeding on a second attempt at something that failed the first time — retry an activity or challenge you failed once. Check the sources for the latest confirmed method before spending long on it. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED: the guide community (PowerPyx and Keengamer) has not yet confirmed the exact unlock for this trophy, so treat this as the best-known approach, not a certainty. The description suggests witnessing something strange or unexpected in the world — an odd event or encounter while free-roaming. Check the sources for the latest confirmed method before spending long on it. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED: the guide community (PowerPyx and Keengamer) has not yet confirmed the exact unlock for this trophy, so treat this as the best-known approach, not a certainty. The description points to a melee drive-by at the bowling alley — knocking people or pins over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle near the lanes. Check the sources for the latest confirmed method before spending long on it. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from bank jobs and payday loan jobs. Launder them by selling to your contacts until you have moved $250,000 in total — the amount is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so keep laundering every batch you earn rather than hoarding it. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across every kind of shop in the game — clothes, weapons, food, car parts, anything. The amount is cumulative, so it fills up naturally as you gear up for other trophies; if you are short at the end, buy and sell high-value items to push the total over the line. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The total cost is around $160,000. Note that garages given to you by the story do not count — only the eight you buy yourself. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray and then Register; from Chapter 3 you can also do it at a Pay 'n' Spray with a tracker fitted. Register ten vehicles in total, and keep a free garage space for each one or the registration will not go through. Sources: PowerPyx, Keengamer.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
